labels = sns.barplot(df_train.labels.value_counts().index,df_train.labels.value_counts())

This is using an old Seaborn API where `barplot()` accepted `x` and `y` as positional arguments. In newer versions of Seaborn (v0.11+), the API has changed to only accept keyword arguments for x and y.

The fix is to change it to:
```python
labels = sns.barplot(x=df_train.labels.value_counts().index, y=df_train.labels.value_counts())
```
